commands: cardmodel arcade serve (the In progress page)
name: live_hub
statement: The store follows everything in progress: project cards say what to watch and keep their owner's detail current (CM41); the hub computes each one's phase, branches, uncommitted work, metrics and builds from git and the model's records, read-only, gathers what waits on the user, and pushes changes to the launcher as they happen; early-access builds install beside the release.
usefulness: One live page shows what is being built, where, by which branch, how far along, and lets you play it early.
